I'll analyze this GitHub issue about a sample rate mismatch between Volcano Engine TTS and a client protocol.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a sample rate mismatch between two systems - the Volcano Engine TTS (which has a default sample rate of 24000) and a client protocol (with a default of 16000). This is causing audio distortion when played on the client side. This is a configuration/compatibility issue that can be verified without building or running code. The solution would likely involve either configuring the TTS to output at 16000Hz or implementing sample rate conversion. An LLM can verify the correctness of such a solution by analyzing the configuration parameters and API documentation of the Volcano Engine TTS service. No actual build environment is needed to confirm that matching the sample rates or implementing proper conversion would resolve the audio distortion issue.
